rows.evidence: plan-readers.ts:219-222 is the only record decoder that accepts a TaskReductionSnapshot without completion; contracts/reduction.ts:66-67 says the field is optional only for historical rows. newTaskReductionRecord (state/task-machine.ts:473-507) always writes completion, and its only commit is completion.ts:469: grep for TASK_REDUCTION_SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA_ID / encodeTaskReductionSnapshot shows no other writer, and there is no migration code in src. Hand-edited or old-format records are the only source of the shape; decision 79-1 (docs/refactor/HANDOFF.md:565-566) drops old-format decoding.
rows.proposal_note: Sound. The optionality comes from the R3e batch (docs/refactor/tasks/R3e-completion-skeleton.md:298, :361: 'add an optional versioned completion audit'), which 79-1 supersedes; also tighten completion-record-codecs.ts:135 (TaskCompleted event result has the same optional acceptance) in the same change, otherwise a replayed old event still decodes without completion.

rows.evidence: positions is filled at plan-readers.ts:697 from decodePlanProposalOrigin; the null fallback at :765 runs only when origin.since is absent or the key is missing, and every candidate_v2 key in the same loop is present (decision-read-model.ts:1650-1683 does the same). decodePlanProposalOrigin (persistence/plan-record-codecs.ts:984-997) returns {} only for a record with no since and refuses a persisted null (:989-991). New chains bind since (plan-service.ts:1421-1423, :3352-3354); replacements/adoption/abandon copy it (plan-service.ts:1326-1350, :1721, :2400, :2458; plan-commit-compiler.ts:245, :436). Only a replacement of a pre-slice head (replacedOrigin undefined) can keep the absence, i.e. old data.
rows.proposal_note: Sound, but make the replacement copy refuse/upgrade a since-less head (plan-service.ts:1326-1350) instead of re-encoding it without since, otherwise the newly required decoder can still be handed an invalid record on the old-data path.

rows.evidence: plan-readers.ts:1201 then-arm needs the lease's holderRunId absent from runById. runById is filled in the same read window from every RUN_BY_TASK/RUN_BY_GOAL candidate of the selected tasks (plan-readers.ts:1642-1678), so a same-goal Run of the task is present. claimTask writes the Lease, Attempt and Run in one commit from the same claim (claim-service.ts:1206-1215, :1246-1284; run-machine.ts:841 takes planRef from the claim), and plan-readers.ts:1199 returns free before this lookup for a released lease. The store has no record delete (ports.ts:188-196), so only a hand-written/hidden Run reaches the arm.
rows.proposal_note: Keeping the conservative-occupancy guard untested (rule 4) is right; codex's tighten-and-delete alternative is possible only after a cross-record invariant is written down, and it buys nothing today.

rows.evidence: plan-readers.ts:1283 then-arm needs a round returned by the gate's index whose subject/ref disagree with the gate. The index is keyed on ref.projectId/workspaceId/goalId/taskId (evidence-record-codecs.ts:767-768); the only round writer builds ref from scope plus the subject (evidence-service.ts:1112-1116) and successors copy ref/subject from the predecessor; validation only checks the predecessor ref (evidence-record-codecs.ts:250-280). A mismatch therefore needs a row written outside the platform, and refusing it to unavailable (:1283-1286) is the intended corrupt-index handling.
rows.proposal_note: Keep without a tamper test (rule 4); the guard is what turns a corrupt index row into unavailable instead of a wrong chain.

rows.evidence: plan-readers.ts:1336 right operand runs only when plan is null. Both production callers refuse that state before the call: note-update-due.ts:186-189 (`if (window.plan !== null)`) and note-views.ts:418-427 (`plan.value === null` yields empty triggers without calling readGoalTriggerRecords). grep over src finds no other caller outside tests; a Goal with no adopted plan is real, but it never reaches this read. The deleted S4C2-3e/3h tests passed null directly.
rows.proposal_note: Narrowing the parameter to PlanRevisionSnapshot is safe: both call sites already pass non-null, and the internal `plan !== null` branches (:1343, :1394) then go with it.

rows.evidence: plan-readers.ts:1365 else-arm needs refKeys empty. With the non-null plan of A1-048, tasks = plan.tasks (:1336) and reductionKeys (:1359) has one key per task. Every adopted plan has at least one task: plan-validation.ts:59-64 requires a required work task or an explicit work intent and apply refuses on draftIssues (plan-service.ts:1686-1687, :2981-2983). The empty set was only reachable with plan null and no ended Run (deleted S4C2-3h).
rows.proposal_note: Sound only as part of the same change as A1-048; deleting the guard while the parameter stayed nullable would expose the empty plan-null path.

rows.evidence: plan-readers.ts:1527 then-arm needs readMany to answer unsupported for the TaskRequeue/TaskReworkRefusal keys. The one production backend is built in create-platform.ts:671-674 with TASK_CLAIM_RECORD_SCHEMAS (create-platform.ts:628), which registers both aggregates (claim-record-codecs.ts:812-818). readMany returns unsupported only when no schema is registered for the aggregate type (sqlite-record-store.ts:357-364; in-memory-record-store.ts:231-236). grep finds no other backend construction in src, so the narrow-store capability gap exists only in tests.
rows.proposal_note: Delete :1527 and the comment at :1510-1513; no current test reaches the arm (it is this uncovered row) and no exhaustive switch or type depends on the unsupported result.

rows.evidence: plan-readers.ts:1716 then-arm needs a requiredBasisSources ref still absent from index after readOriginPlans. That reader reports missing only for an absent record (plan-readers.ts:2179-2191), and the store port has no delete (ports.ts:188-196; only DELETE_CLAIM_SQL at sqlite-record-store.ts:105). buildTargetTaskBasis (plan-task-basis.ts:120-150) names the target itself for changed/added tasks or the same-Goal source's existing basis for unchanged ones; T1-064 confirmed plans are never removed. Only a hidden/deleted Plan record reaches it.
rows.proposal_note: Keep untested per rule 4: this is the hard-dependency refusal, not a state a platform writer can produce, and a tamper test is explicitly not to be restored.

rows.evidence: plan-readers.ts:1790 then-arm needs verifyBasisDelegation to refuse the selected plan's own task. A missing source is already caught at :1716 (A1-055); the remaining refusals are another goal, a later revision, a missing definition, disagreeing definitions and a non-absolute source (plan-task-basis.ts:280-306). Writers inherit only the same-Goal source's basis for unchanged tasks and the target itself for changed/added ones (plan-task-basis.ts:126-150), so a current Plan passes; only a rewritten immutable Plan record makes it fail (T1-064's three read-back faults).
rows.proposal_note: Keep without a test: rule 4, and the before-T faults were rewrites of the immutable P1 record.

rows.evidence: plan-readers.ts:1803 then-arm needs a Run in runByTask whose planRef key is absent from index. index starts with the selected plan (:1707) and adds every factOriginRefs plan returned by readOriginPlans (:1698-1712), which reports missing only for an absent record (:2183-2191). claimTask is the only Run creator and builds the Run from the claim (claim-service.ts:1206-1215, :457-460; run-machine.ts:841; :1523 keeps claim.planRef), and Plans are never deleted (ports.ts:188-196). Only a Run hand-written to a non-existent Plan reaches the arm.
rows.proposal_note: Keep the conservative unresolvable trace without a tamper test (rule 4); the alternative is not to delete the branch, because it keeps corruption from becoming free.
